headline: Contested Sectors Stir as Fronts Reopen
war_summary: The latest returns show several fronts stirring after the previous lull. Weathered Expanse remains the chief furnace, with six base events in two hours and 49 in the day; its holdings are divided among three Warden, four Colonial, and two neutral bases, while both casualty streams remain exceptionally heavy. Callahan’s Passage has quieted sharply in the immediate window—no events in two hours—though 29 daily events and enormous losses keep its ten Warden bases under scrutiny. Nevish Line has reopened with four events in two hours, after none in the prior edition’s immediate window; the sector now stands at five Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral bases. Stlican Shelf has also become active again, recording eight events in two hours and 24 across the day, with one Warden and eight Colonial holdings. Kuura Strand is another fresh flashpoint, with eight events in 24 hours and both casualty rates accelerating. Palantine Berm has gone quiet for the moment, but its 28 daily events mark it as a recently unsettled sector. Much of the remainder remains still.
